The metaphysical embodiment of war itself — not a soldier fighting for a cause; the cause. It forms in the hearts of battlefields where conflict raged for centuries. It will arm one side of a fight solely to turn on them later. Its only goal is that the battle never ends.

Qliphah: Thagirion, the Conflicts — the Hull of Tiferet. The balance point of the Tree, replaced by a blade's edge.

Still recognizably what it was. That is the worst part.

Every finger of every grandfather has an opinion. He listens to all of them.

They were told the hum would stop. It did not stop.

The Dream-Twister moves through creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain, taking 1d10 kinetic damage if it ends its turn inside something solid. It hovers; floors are a fiction it declines to sign.

do.prompt: Unbodied: moves through things; 1d10 kinetic if it ends inside something solid.

description.value: The Dream-Twister reaches into one Shaken creature within 12 squares and pulls its fear out through the mirror of the world: a shadow-thing steps free (GM: use a T1 wraith-type statblock, hostile to everyone). It lasts a minute — or until someone is brave enough at it.

do.prompt: Manifest Fear: a T1 wraith steps out of one Shaken creature ≤12 sq, hostile to all.

system.effect: A hand of smoke closes around the waking mind. Damage goes straight to Stress.
system.flavor: A shadowy, clawed hand reaching into a sleeping head — except you're awake.

description.value: The Dream-Twister makes two Dread Touch attacks.

The Dream-Twister slides halfway out of the world into the shallow edge of the dream-layer. Until the start of its next turn only psychic or sephirotic damage can touch it; everything else passes through the space where it almost is.

One sleeping or unconscious creature within 12 squares. It rolls vs Resolve (DC 16). Fail: 4d10 psychic damage (Stress), the rest is ruined — no benefit from it, no Soma Break refresh — and until it completes an untwisted night's sleep it rolls twice-keep-worse on Resolve checks, deeply disturbed by what it almost remembers dreaming.

do.prompt: Rest ruined: no benefit, no Soma Break refresh; worse Resolve checks until a clean sleep.

description.value:
Any creature that starts its turn within 4 squares must succeed a Resolve check (DC by tier) or take 1d4 psychic damage to Stress as a repressed impulse surfaces, spoken aloud.

Gamaliel — hull of yesod.

rules.label: Aura of Obscenity

description.value: When the War Incarnate fails a check, ten thousand fallen soldiers refuse the outcome on its behalf. Three times per scene.

system.effect: Reach 2. Axe, maul, greatsword, or flail — its choice, and it likes variety within a single turn.
system.flavor: Four arms, four arguments, one conclusion.

description.value: Any creature that starts its turn within 6 squares is flooded with bloodlust: it rolls twice-keep-better on melee attacks, but must roll vs Resolve (DC 16) or spend its action attacking the nearest creature — whoever that happens to be. The effect ends when it starts a turn outside the aura, breathing hard.

do.prompt: Bloodlust: twice-keep-better on melee attacks this turn.

description.value: Deals double damage to objects and structures. Walls are just slow enemies.

The War Incarnate makes one Weapon Limb attack against an armored creature. On a hit, besides the damage, the target's Guard drops by 2 until the armor is repaired or the wearer's next Soma Break. A given creature can only be Shattered once — after that there is nothing left to disrespect.

1d3 war-echoes rise from the ground in unoccupied squares within 6 squares (GM: use a T1 wraith-type statblock, e.g. Salt Wraith). They act on the Incarnate's initiative, fight for it, and disperse after a minute — or when the battle does, whichever it can prevent longer.

do.prompt: Summon Echoes of War: 1d3 T1 wraiths in squares ≤6 sq, on its initiative.

description.value: The War Incarnate makes three Weapon Limb attacks.

A creature that touches it or ends its turn adjacent to it takes 2d10 psychic damage (Stress). It stands for a minute, or until the demon drops.

do.prompt: Wall of Nullity: 6×2-sq wall ≤12 sq; touch or end adjacent → 2d10 psychic Stress.

description.value: The demon makes two Mind-Numbing Slam attacks.

system.effect: On a hit the target also takes 2d6 psychic damage to Stress, and rolls Body vs DC 16 or is Staggered until the end of its next turn — the blow lands on the brain, wherever it hits.
system.flavor: A fist like a wrecking ball with an opinion about your IQ.

description.value: The 3 squares around the demon are difficult terrain — thought itself moves slowly there. A creature that starts its turn in the aura has its speed halved until the start of its next turn, and rolls twice-keep-worse on checks to maintain a manifestation.

do.prompt: Aura of Stagnation: speed halved; twice-keep-worse on manifestation upkeep.

description.value: Reaction. When a manifestation targets the demon or includes it in an area, the caster rolls Soul vs DC 16. Fail: the working collapses into nothing and the caster gains +1 Noise. The demon does not gloat. It has no face to gloat with.

do.prompt: Spell Scramble (reaction): caster targeting it — Soul DC 16 or the working fails, +1 Noise.

system.flavor: A blinding green blast with a screaming skull at its heart.

description.value: The Inferno flows through gaps an inch wide. A creature that touches it or hits it with a melee attack from within 1 square takes 2d6 thermal (hot) damage. It can enter hostile spaces and stop there; the first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 2d6 thermal (hot).

do.prompt: Entering a creature's space (first time this turn): 2d6 thermal to it.

description.value: The Inferno chooses a 2×2-square patch of ground within 12 squares. It becomes molten slag for a minute: difficult terrain, and 2d10 thermal (hot) damage to any creature that starts its turn there or enters for the first time on a turn.

do.prompt: Melt Ground: 2×2 slag ≤12 sq for 1 min; start/enter → 2d10 thermal.

system.flavor: A jet of green fire that solidifies into a clawed, grasping hand.

description.value: At the start of each of the Inferno's turns, every creature within 6 squares takes 2d6 thermal (hot) damage — and any protection it has against thermal damage is burned away until the start of the Inferno's next turn (treat thermal resistance as absent).

do.prompt: Thermal resistance is burned away until the Inferno's next turn.

description.value: The Angel relocates up to 24 squares in a flourish of golden light. It never simply walks. Walking is for the adored.

system.effect: A rod of gorgeous, devouring gold light. What it burns away doesn't scar — it just isn't yours anymore.
system.flavor: Beautiful. Genuinely. That's the problem.

description.value: The beautiful form flickers, and for one instant everyone sees what casts that shadow. Each creature within 6 squares that can see the Angel rolls vs Resolve (DC 18). Fail: 3d10 psychic damage (Stress) and Shaken. Repeat the check at the end of each of its turns to recover. The Angel does not use this ability by choice — the GM may fire it when the Angel drops below half Integrity.
The Angel makes two attacks with its Scepter of Vanity.
The Angel rolls twice and keeps the better result on checks to resist manifestations. Other people's workings are, frankly, in poor taste.

Any creature that starts its turn within 12 squares and can see the Angel rolls vs Resolve (DC 18). Fail: Charmed and Staggered — incapacitated with adoration. The effect breaks if the creature takes damage or an ally spends an action shaking them out of it. On a success, the creature is immune to this Presence for a day: it has seen the shadow.

do.prompt: Also Staggered (adoration); damage or an ally's action breaks it.

system.effect: An 18-square line of false radiance, one square wide. Each creature in the line rolls an Evasion check vs DC 18. Fail: full damage to Stress and Blinded — the beam is full of tiny screaming skulls, and seeing that costs. Repeat Body vs DC 18 at end of turns to clear the blindness. Success: half damage, eyes shut in time.
system.flavor: Brilliant gold, and wrong all the way through.

description.value: When the Angel fails a check, it declares the failure beneath it, and succeeds instead. Three times per scene. The mask cracks a little each time.

Any creature that starts its turn within 6 squares and can see this creature rolls twice-keep-worse on checks to resist being Charmed until the start of its next turn.

Samael — hull of hod.

do.prompt: Aura of Vanity: twice-keep-worse on checks to resist being Charmed while it can be seen.

description.value: Up to three creatures within 24 squares roll vs Resolve (DC 18) or are Restrained by chains of golden light for a minute, taking 2d8 psychic damage (Stress) at the start of each of their turns. A chained creature can spend its action on a Presence check vs DC 18 — denying the Angel's glory out loud — to burst the chains. The Angel finds this genuinely hurtful.

do.prompt: Burst the chains: an action on a Presence DC 18.

description.value:
Any creature that starts its turn within 6 squares hears faint whispers in a voice it knows: it rolls twice-keep-worse on checks to read intentions or see through deception until the start of its next turn.

Satariel — hull of binah.

do.prompt: Aura of Concealment: twice-keep-worse on checks to read intentions or see through deception.

system.effect: Ranged, 6/12 squares. On a hit the target is Restrained by shadow-silk (escape: Violence check vs DC 12). While Restrained, the web shows the target its worst fear wearing a familiar face: Resolve check vs DC 12 or Shaken while the web holds.
Venom that attacks certainty instead of flesh. Damage goes to Stress as the target briefly cannot tell which of its memories are real.
system.flavor: A fang dripping doubt.

description.value: The Veil-Spinner wraps itself in spun nothing and turns invisible until it attacks or loses the thread of the working.
Climbs any surface, including upside down, without a check — and ignores movement restrictions from any webbing, its own or otherwise.
In direct sunlight the Veil-Spinner rolls twice and keeps the worse result on attacks and sight-based checks. Honest light is the one thing it cannot spin.
